title: Realistic rebuild: Flying Dutchman and the four Celestial Pillars
player_outcome: The Flying Dutchman is a ragged ghost ship with torn glowing sails and cannons. Each Celestial Pillar has its own silhouette (Solar, Vortex, Nebula, Stardust) inside a shimmering shield.
design: flying_dutchman: plank hull, masts, torn translucent sails, 4 cannon models (for future parts), lanterns with glow.

The four pillars: a carved core per style (solar flares, vortex spirals, nebula tendrils, stardust constellations), a floating ring, and a shield shell (prop:*:clear) whose visibility the renderer already ties to ShieldUp.
tests: build_all.py --check; LunarTests and invasion smoke stay green
verification: Preview sheets and boss gallery screenshots
risks: If the shield shell is a separate mesh that the pillar code does not toggle, add a model variant swap (ModelOverride) when the shield drops.
